To publish all changes:

  1. Click the Publish button at the top of your site
  2. This will make your changes live across all pages and settings

  1. Open the Pages panel

3. Select Site settings

To export your presentation to PowerPoint or Google Slides:

For PowerPoint:

  1. Click Share at the top right, then select Export
  2. Choose PowerPoint (PPTX) format
  3. Your file will download automatically and you'll receive an email copy

For Google Slides:

Export as PowerPoint first, then upload the PPTX file to Google Slides

If export fails, try:

  • Check your internet connection
  • Split very long presentations into smaller sections
  • Compress large images that might be causing issues

The exported content will match how it appears in Present Mode, not Edit Mode

To remove your custom domain from your website in Gamma, just follow these steps:

  1. Open your Gamma site editor.
  2. Click on Site Settings (usually found in the top-right corner by clicking on the three dots).
  3. Go to the Custom Domain section.
  4. Click the trash icon next to your custom domain to remove it from Gamma.
  5. Save your changes.
  6. Then, go to your domain provider's website and access the DNS settings. Clear the A and CNAME records so your domain no longer points to Gamma.

Once you've done all of that, please go ahead and add your domain to Gamma again, and add the DNS records pointing to Gamma manually on your domain provider's end. Do not touch the DNS setting or interrupt the verification process during the next 24-48 hours once it's added.

The charge of $96 instead of $8 may be due to per-member billing—if your workspace included multiple members, you would be billed for each one, which can increase the total charge significantly. To review your charges and manage your subscription, go to Settings & members in the left panel, then open the Billing tab and select Manage subscription. Here, you can view your invoices, update payment methods, and cancel your subscription.

Refunds are only available within the first 7 days of subscribing, and only after contacting support. Since refund processing and removal of credit card details require human assistance, your request will need to be handled by a human agent.

To cancel your subscription, use the Cancel subscription option in the Billing tab. After cancellation, your subscription remains active until the end of the current billing cycle, and no further charges will occur unless you resubscribe. Removing your credit card details also requires human support intervention.

For your refund and card removal requests, please ask to speak with a human agent so they can assist you directly.

conversation_parts.body:
You can integrate your Gamma landing page with your CRM's website by embedding it using an iframe code.

Here's how to do it:

Generate the embed code:

  1. Open your Gamma landing page
  2. Click the Share button in the top-right corner
  3. Select Embed from the dropdown

Enable public access:

  1. Toggle Allow public access so your landing page is viewable when embedded
  2. Copy the generated iframe code

Add to your CRM website:

Most site builders that support custom HTML blocks will work with this method. Simply paste the iframe code into an HTML block on your CRM's website.

Make sure your iframe dimensions are responsive or manually adjust width and height as needed for optimal display.

conversation_parts.body:
To format a photo to fit properly in Gamma, you have several options depending on your image type:

For standard images:

  • Click and drag the corners to resize proportionally
  • Use the Crop tool: click the image, select Crop from the toolbar, adjust the selection, and click Apply

For accent images (part of card layouts):

  • Switch between Fit Mode (keeps entire image visible) and Fill Mode (expands to cover area, cropping edges) in the image menu
  • Adjust the focus point by clicking "Change focus point" and dragging the circle to reposition what's visible
  • Manually adjust width by clicking and dragging the edge

For images in smart layouts:

  • Select the image and use the layout menu to adjust size and position
  • Use the focus point tool to reposition the image within the layout

You can also resize any image by clicking and dragging its borders after insertion.

To add footnotes that appear at the bottom of your card:

  1. Highlight the text where you want to add a footnote
  2. Click "Add Footnote" from the text formatting menu that appears
  3. A footnote will appear at the bottom of the card where you can enter your reference

The footnote content is housed within the footnote number - click on the footnote number to view or edit the content.

For superscripts (which you can use for custom footnotes), we support them within math blocks using the ^ symbol. For example, type x^2 for superscripts. However, this is specifically for mathematical notation rather than general text formatting.

Our built-in footnote feature automatically handles the formatting and placement at the bottom of cards, which might be more efficient than creating custom superscript footnotes.

conversation_parts.body:
When presentations have lengthy edit histories causing duplication prompts, try copying the content manually instead of using the standard duplicate function.

Here's how to recreate your presentation:

  1. Open the Pages Panel - Click the Pages icon in the top-left of your presentation
  2. Select All Content - Use Cmd + A (Mac) or Ctrl + A (Windows) to select all cards on the current page, then right-click and select Copy or use Cmd + C / Ctrl + C
  3. Create Fresh Presentation - Go to your dashboard, click Create New, choose Presentation, then paste the copied cards using Cmd + V / Ctrl + V
  4. Repeat for Each Page - If your presentation has multiple pages, repeat this process for each page

This method bypasses the edit history issue by creating entirely new content rather than duplicating the problematic file structure.

  • Import with AI - Restyls and transforms content during import

content_sources.title: How do I merge cards and combine gammas?
How can I import slides or documents into Gamma?

conversation_parts.body:
Yes, you can combine multiple presentations into one using our copy-paste method.

Here's how:

  1. Select all cards from the first presentation by pressing Cmd + A (Mac) or Ctrl + A (Windows) twice in the filmstrip
  2. Copy with Cmd + C (Mac) or Ctrl + C (Windows)
  3. Open your target presentation where you want to combine everything
  4. Paste using Cmd + V (Mac) or Ctrl + V (Windows)

Repeat this process for each additional presentation you want to merge. The pasted cards will keep their content and formatting but adopt the theme of your target presentation.

Alternatively, you can import external presentations (like PowerPoint files) directly into Gamma using our Import feature from the dashboard.

How do I delete slides or will more credit be taken

You can delete slides (called "cards") in Gamma without using any additional credits. To do this:

  1. Open your Gamma project.
  2. Find the filmstrip on the left side of the screen.
  3. Click on the card (slide) you want to delete to highlight it.
  4. Press Delete (Windows) or Backspace (Mac) on your keyboard.

If you accidentally delete a card, you can undo the action by pressing Command + Z (Mac) or Ctrl + Z (Windows). Deleting cards does not use any credits—credits are only used for AI actions like generating new content or images, not for editing or deleting slides.

  2. Choose an accent image layout (e.g., top, background).

Access the Members list:

  2. Select Settings & members
  3. Click the Members tab

Remove the user:

  • You might not have admin privileges to view all members
  • They could be in a different workspace

Only admins can add or remove users, so if you can't see the removal option, you'll need to ask another admin to help.

To remove the "Made with Gamma" watermark, you'll need a paid plan (Plus or Pro).

For paid users:

  • Open your presentation and go to Share > Advanced Settings
  • Toggle Hide 'Made by Gamma' on, then refresh and re-share/re-export

If the watermark persists:

  • Verify your subscription is active in Settings → Manage Subscription
  • Re-export the presentation (older exports retain watermarks)

If your presentation was created on a Free account:

  • Open a blank project in your paid workspace
  • Copy all cards from the original presentation into the new project
  • Export from the paid workspace to remove branding

The watermark appears because presentations created under Free plans retain the badge even after upgrading.

You can add your logo in several ways:

Through Custom Themes:

  1. Go to Themes and click the three-dot menu (…) on an existing theme

Using Headers and Footers (Pro users only):

For Workspace Branding:

Go to Settings & members in the left sidebar, then under the Overview tab you can upload a workspace logo

For Website Navigation:

Enable the navigation bar from Site Settings (three-dot menu), then add your logo to the left section of the navbar

Custom themes with logos are automatically shared across your workspace.

Para calcular o custo dos créditos, você precisa saber que 1.500 créditos custam $6.

O cálculo é simples:

  • $6 ÷ 1.500 créditos = $0,004 por crédito

Então se você quiser mapear o custo de qualquer funcionalidade, multiplique o número de créditos necessários por $0,004.

Por exemplo:

  • Uma imagem de 2 créditos = 2 × $0,004 = $0,008
  • Uma imagem de 20 créditos = 20 × $0,004 = $0,08

Lembrando que você só pode comprar créditos em incrementos de 1.500, e precisa estar em um plano pago para fazer essa compra.

Here's how to publish your site in Gamma:

To publish all changes:

  1. Click the Publish button at the top of your site
  2. This will make your changes live across all pages and settings

To publish a single page:

  1. Open the Pages panel
  2. Click the three-dot menu (…) beside the page

  1. Click the Publish dropdown in the top-right corner
  2. Select Preview to see how your site looks on desktop, tablet, or mobile
